sn56.50:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, sinerupabbatarājā parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ṭhapetvā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharāti.
sn56.50:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yaṃ vā sinerussa pabbatarājassa parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ, yā vā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā avasiṭṭhāti?
sn56.50:1.4: etadeva bhante, bahutaraṃ sinerussa pabbatarājassa yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ,
sn56.50:1.6: saṅkhampi na upenti, upanidhimpi na upenti, kalabhāgampi na upenti sinerussa pabbatarājassa parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā avasiṭṭhāti.
sn56.50:1.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etadeva bahutaraṃ dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ, appamattakaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ.
sn56.50:1.8: saṅkhampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti, purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuparamatā.
sn56.50:1.9: yo “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn56.50:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
